goal: Сегодня настроить remote-first обходчиков, которые проверяют фабрику и докладывают директору через API.
objective: Реализовать или подготовить к безопасному deploy систему remote observer sweepers: не локальные субагенты на Mac, а серверные обходчики, которые периодически проверяют Control Plane, home kiosk, queued/running/blocked tasks, PR/branch status, fleet health, MIMO runner status и создают structured repair tasks. Обходчики должны докладывать через Fabric API/Control Plane, а не через ручные SSH-циклы.
implementation_requirements: Design the observer as remote server workers with bounded intervals and jitter, not Mac-local subagents.
Define API payloads for observer reports: observed_at, observer_node, subject, status, severity, next_action, repair_task_id.
Add or update scripts/contracts for sweeps of Control Plane health, task queue, home kiosk, PR branches, runner status and stale nodes.
Add deduplication/idempotency so observers do not spam repair tasks.
Add tests or deterministic dry-run fixtures.
Prepare a safe deploy plan for systemd timer/service on selected remote nodes with rollback.
Do not perform paid provider actions, destructive changes, secret exposure or Telegram receiver changes.
acceptance: Observer/sweeper architecture is remote-first and API-reporting.
Home kiosk, Control Plane queue, PR/branch triage, fleet health and runner status are covered.
Deduplication/backoff prevents spam and lease storms.
Safe deploy and rollback plan exists for remote systemd timer/service.
No Mac-local subagent dependency is introduced.
Exact required run artifacts are created.
